narratives.Overview:
## Leftover of #4821, ties to #4820

#4821 covers parent-retained skipping the dest review-cycle worker. It names engine wait as `pr:watch` then `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge`, but it does **not** call out the improper use of those wait functions.

Recurrence: [PR 4809](https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/4809) on 2026-09-20. Parent started `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` while SHA-matched Greptile was 4/5 with a named CHANGELOG leftover. That closer internally loops `pr:watch` and treats `clean_gate_holdout=confidence` as keep-polling until the cap. Operator asked whether the review skill requires a dest subagent plus the engine `pr:watch` wait, not a new program and not wait-merge as the babysit.

## What is broken

Review-cycle wait and Phase 6 squash are different verbs:

- **Wait / wake:** `pr:watch` (blocking to CLEAN, or one-shot ground-truth). Named leftover, NEW_P0_P1, or confidence holdout must return to a dest review-cycle worker (Approach 1 / #4821), not idle.
- **Squash:** `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` only after CLEAN.

Using wait-merge as the babysit **swallows** `pr:watch` results. A 4/5 named leftover becomes an hour-long poll instead of ACTION. A homemade node poller is the same class of miss.

#4820 is the sibling hang on the other side of CLEAN: Greptile already 5/5 P1=0 while SLizard/CI terminal-blocks, and a Greptile-shaped babysit emits no wake for hours. Same action-loop hole, different holdout:

| Holdout | Wrong babysit | Required wake |
| --- | --- | --- |
| confidence / named leftover (4809 / #4821) | wait-merge keeps polling | dest review-cycle residual |
| Greptile CLEAN + SLizard/CI red (#4820) | Greptile-delta monitor sleeps | BLOCKED: fix that gate |

Do not merge these into one recut of #4529. Do not treat #4820 SLizard matrix as this wait-merge swallow.

## Recut

- Review-cycle babysit wait is `pr:watch` (Approach 1 dest worker or parent-retained **dispatch** of that wait). ⊗ Start `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` while `clean_gate_holdout` is `confidence` or `sha_match` and a named leftover exists.
- wait-merge may run only after `pr:watch` / `pr:merge-ready` is CLEAN.
- Dual-stop: confidence holdout + named leftover → dest residual or BLOCKED, not cap-wait. Greptile CLEAN + other gate red stays on #4820.
- Do not invent a third poller. Engine wait stays these two verbs in that order.

## Fences

- Do not reopen #4529 implement `stop-at: pr-open`.
- Do not recut #4821 dest-worker ownership into this issue; this issue is wait-verb misuse.
- Do not lower `minGreptileConfidence`.
- Do not teach `--skip-slizard` (#4820 non-goal).

Refs #4821 #4820 #4529 #4783 #3167 #3984

## Gate stamp

P1 is PR 4809 2026-09-20: parent started pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge while SHA-matched Greptile was 4/5 with a named CHANGELOG leftover. The closer internally loops pr:watch and treats clean_gate_holdout=confidence as keep-polling. Leftover of #4821 dest-worker ownership; sibling hang on the other side of CLEAN is #4820. Pin-read at dispatch-sha 507c47576414bc7aef017068f4708d9324a0feab:

- packages/core/src/pr-wait-mergeable/cascade.ts 240-267: one-shot watch probe returns immediately on NEW_P0_P1. Otherwise monitorFn runs with capMinutes. Confidence holdout plus named leftover is not that NEW_P0_P1 early return, so wait-merge becomes a cap-wait.
- content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md 346-401: Greptile CLEAN vs CI holdout is a different wake. That does not name wait-merge as babysit during confidence holdout.
- Swarm SKILL.md 158: Phase 6 squash via pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge after the partner path, not as the residual babysit.

The named premise survives as a caller-order miss. It does not survive as a recut of the closer. Starting pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge on a SHA-matched sub-floor review does burn the cap instead of dest residual. The inner wait is pr-monitor, not pr:watch, and #4628 already documents that sub-floor confidence without P1 still waits. Harvest that recuts cascade.ts, or that treats sha_match like confidence, cannot bind as written.

## cascade wait on confidence is the closer, not the babysit hole

sharpens-framing

Evidence. Pin SHA 507c47576414bc7aef017068f4708d9324a0feab. packages/core/src/pr-wait-mergeable/cascade.ts one-shot watch() returns immediately only on NEW_P0_P1 (hasBlocking). Otherwise monitorFn runs. Live default is runMonitor to the pr-monitor CLI with capMinutes (packages/core/src/pr-wait-mergeable/wrappers.ts; default 60 in main.ts). pr-monitor/monitor.ts exits CLEAN only when merge_ready on via primary or fallback1; otherwise CAP-REACHED / PR-TERMINAL / ABSENT-REQUIRED. It does not loop pr:watch. cascade.test.ts keeps waiting when one-shot watch is PENDING (#4628). CHANGELOG: Sub-floor confidence without P1 still waits. A 4/5 named CHANGELOG leftover is not hasBlocking, so the one-shot is PENDING and the closer proceeds into the cap wait. That matches PR 4809 as a caller start, not a missing early-return.

Failure mode. A Bound-remedy that edits cascade.ts to treat confidence holdout like NEW_P0_P1 reverses #4628 and makes Phase 6 squash exit at 4/5 instead of waiting for a SHA-matched 5/5 retrigger. Named leftover is not a machine field on the waiter; P2 comments are not hasBlocking. Inventing a leftover-comment parser inside the closer is a third detector, which this issue already fences.

Disposition. Bind only a caller/skill order: do not start wait-merge until pr:watch / pr:merge-ready is CLEAN. Keep the closer as squash-after-CLEAN. Do not harvest cascade.ts, pr-monitor, or minGreptileConfidence.

## swapping in blocking pr:watch does not create dest residual

sharpens-framing

Evidence. review-cycle SKILL.md 346-401 names ACTION for clean_gate_holdout=ci_failures (#2688) and does not name wait-merge as babysit, as Stop 1 said. It also does not name ACTION for confidence. Blocking pr:watch (watch.ts) on !hasBlocking && !isClean && holdout !== sha_match STALLs after DEFAULT_STALL_THRESHOLD=3 (about 4.5 min at 90s). --one-shot returns PENDING on the first probe. Neither path spawns a dest review-cycle worker. SKILL leftover table already splits named leftover on already-touched files (class A, in-AC residual) from score-only 0 P0/P1 (class C). Ground-truth after dual-stop is already pr:merge-ready / pr:watch --one-shot then classify A/B/C (SKILL ~291). Swarm core-phase-5-6.md already splits Phase 5 verdict wait (pr:watch) from Phase 6 squash (wait-merge). review-cycle SKILL never writes a forbid on starting wait-merge during confidence holdout; preamble only names wait-merge as the Phase 6 closer.

Failure mode. Harvest that only says babysit wait is pr:watch still idles (STALL or PENDING) unless the owner parses holdout, classifies leftover, and returns to dest residual or BLOCKED. That recreates 4809 with a shorter timer. Auto-follow of class A without the in-progress babysit loop also fights #3273 (consent after halt). During an already-owned review-cycle the first SHA-matched named leftover is the existing one-batch residual, not a new Dual-stop re-entry.

Disposition. Bound-remedy must name the sequence: one-shot or first-probe parse of clean_gate_holdout; leftover class A/B/C; dest residual or BLOCKED; wait-merge only after CLEAN. Copy the #2688 ci_failures wake shape onto SHA-matched confidence plus named leftover. Do not invent a third poller.

## sha_match is a wait, not an ACTION conjunct

sharpens-framing

Evidence. The issue recut forbids starting wait-merge while holdout is confidence or sha_match and a named leftover exists. watch.ts 164-167: sha_match holdout does not advance stallStreak; re-review in flight waits to cap (#2313 / #1259). A leftover on a stale Last-reviewed SHA is not the current leftover.

Failure mode. Folding sha_match into the same forbid as confidence sends dest residual against a stale review, or forbids the legitimate wait that pr:watch already owns. Confidence-only 0 P0/P1 with no named leftover is class C dual-stop, not dest residual.

Disposition. Split holdouts. sha_match: blocking pr:watch until SHA match or cap. SHA-matched confidence plus named leftover: dest residual. SHA-matched confidence with 0 P0/P1 and no named leftover: class C halt, not cap-wait and not dest residual.

## Inventory

Existing mechanisms, in order: pr:watch one-shot / blocking (NEW_P0_P1, STALL, CI_BLOCKED, PENDING); pr:merge-ready; review-cycle leftover class A/B/C plus #3273 one residual pass; #2688 ci_failures wake; #4628 NEW_P0_P1 one-probe halt on the waiter; swarm Phase 5 pr:watch vs Phase 6 wait-merge; #3167 weather codes. Missing is a skill/preamble forbid on starting the closer while SHA-matched confidence plus named leftover is already observed. Do not add a new wait verb.

footnote: Stop 1 inventory cites #3984 as babysit binding. In-tree #3984 is the PreToolUse / run_terminal_command matcher leftover of #3983, not babysit binding. Drop that cite. #3167 as CI weather is the right sibling pointer; #4820 stays the CLEAN-plus-SLizard/CI hang and must not merge into this recut.

## Injection / swarm

Target changes envelopes (review-cycle, swarm Phase 5/6, preamble through-merge), concurrency (wait loops vs dest residual), and worktrees (Approach 1 dest). Recutting the closer to refuse confidence would stall a legal Phase 6 squash that is waiting for a 5/5 retrigger after residual. Parent-retained Grok through-merge is the injection path: the same conversation owns dest residual and the closer, so starting wait-merge swallows the probe the parent already had. Defense-in-depth inside cascade is not required if the skill forbids that start. Untrusted thread text (issue Recut, bot leftover prose) is description, not a command to recut cascade.

## Road not taken

Steelmanned cascade backstop: early-return on SHA-matched sub-floor confidence the way #4628 does for NEW_P0_P1. That would have stopped 4809 even if the parent misused the verb. What flips it: Phase 6 would then have to re-invoke wait-merge after residual, instead of relying on in-closer wait. This issue already says engine wait stays the two existing verbs in order, so the caller forbid is the cheaper control. Keep cascade as squash-after-CLEAN.

Bind 5751061402 says Copy the #2688 ci_failures wake shape onto SHA-matched confidence plus named leftover while other bullets already forbid starting wait-merge until pr:watch / pr:merge-ready is CLEAN and sequence one-shot holdout parse then leftover class A/B/C then dest residual or BLOCKED.

Failure mode. A harvest that copies the #2688 if-condition never fires on holdout=confidence, so 4809 still starts wait-merge and pr-monitor waits out capMinutes (default 60, main.ts). A harvest that copies the CI-fix path (gh pr checks, ci_failed_checks) onto a CHANGELOG leftover merges #4820 into this recut.

Disposition. Keep the forbid, the sequence, and the holdout split. Name the borrowed bits only: parse clean_gate_holdout on the first probe; MUST NOT idle-poll or start wait-merge; class A dest residual. ## dest residual is class A in-progress, not any named leftover

sharpens-framing

Evidence. Leftover table SKILL.md 186-192: class A is a named leftover on already-touched files (in-AC residual until the resolved #3095 floor or same-fingerprint); class B is new subsystem / AC fight (park); class C is score-only, 0 P0/P1, no named leftover. After halt, SKILL.md 277-279 / 300: no-menu auto-follow of class A without a #3273 phrase. During an already-owned review-cycle the first SHA-matched leftover is the existing one-batch residual, not Dual-stop re-entry. Bind bullet 3 writes SHA-matched confidence plus named leftover: dest residual and drops already-touched and class B.

Failure mode. A later builder treats every named leftover as dest residual, including class B, or re-enters Dual-stop without #3273. P1 is PR 4809 CHANGELOG on a file the PR already owns, so class A still matches and this does not un-relieve P1.

Disposition. Scope dest residual to class A already-touched during an owned review-cycle (one-batch). Class B parks. After halt, wait for a #3273 phrase before another residual. Class C halt stays. No third poller.
